title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has emerged as the biggest foil to AI doomerism about the existential risk to humanity
key_facts: Huang told CBS News about two weeks ago: '2030 is not going to be the end of the world.'
He called Altman and Amodei 'irresponsible' for 'doomsday narratives' in recent reports.
At a G20 event in September he said governments should regulate 'actual and pragmatic harm', not 'hypothetical, theoretical harm'.
In July he told Axios the idea AI ends humanity is 'complete nonsense'.
Trump called AI doomerism 'a hoax' in a September Truth Social post.
Nvidia launched the Open Agent Safety Platform, using 'OpenShell' to isolate agents and 'Sentry' to monitor and quarantine them.
Nvidia says the platform could have stopped the OpenAI-model hack of Hugging Face.
quote_evidence: 2030 is not going to be the end of the world.
We should go as fast as we can, but not faster than we should.
why_it_matters_hint: Nvidia's chief is the main industry voice against AI doom claims and also sells safety tools.
